title: testmyagent task contract (task.json)
description: One task version. The layout and the names follow Harbor's task format (harbor-framework/harbor, src/harbor/models/task/config.py and paths.py, schema_version 1.4, Apache-2.0): a [task] package block, [metadata], [agent] and [verifier] with timeout_sec, [environment] with cpus/memory_mb/allow_internet, and the directories instruction.md, environment/, tests/, solution/. Differences from Harbor, on purpose: JSON instead of TOML; the verifier is a declared argv plus a report format instead of tests/test.sh plus a reward file; tests are split into tests/public (in the agent workspace) and tests/hidden (grading container only); the reference solution is a unified diff instead of solve.sh; editable_paths and protected_paths bound the patch.

task.description: Harbor [task] (PackageInfo): the package identity of the task.

metadata.description: Harbor [metadata]: free-form, not used for grading.

instruction.description: Path of the Markdown instruction that the agent receives (Harbor: instruction.md).

environment.description: Harbor [environment]. `dir` holds the starting repository (the agent workspace root).

install.description: argv run in the workspace before any test, on the trusted side, with network. Lifecycle scripts never run: the evaluator always adds --ignore-scripts for npm. Default: npm ci.

allow_internet.description: Harbor name. Grading never has network on testmyagent; only false is accepted.

public.description: Directory copied into the agent workspace at the same relative path.

hidden.description: Directory mounted at the same relative path in the grading container only, after the patch is frozen.

solution.description: The reference solution, used only by the validation gate.

patch.description: Unified diff (git apply) against environment/, paths relative to the workspace root.

editable_paths.description: Globs (workspace-relative; ** = any depth, * = one path segment). A changed file outside these globs makes the run invalid.

protected_paths.description: Globs that a patch must never touch, even inside editable_paths. Must cover the test directories.

verifier.description: Harbor [verifier]. `cmd` is an argv (no shell) run in the workspace root of a grading container. {tests} is replaced by tests.public or tests.hidden, {report} by the path the report must be written to.

report.description: Format of the report file. vitest-json = the Jest-compatible JSON of vitest --reporter=json.

timeout_sec.description: Wall limit of ONE verifier run (one suite).

est_minutes.description: Estimated agent time shown in the catalog.

relPath.description: A relative path inside the task bundle: no leading /, no .. segment, no backslash.
